title: Evaluating the prognostic potential of telomerase signature in breast cancer through advanced machine learning model.
summary: ML-selected six-gene telomerase signature stratified breast-cancer survival across cohorts and linked high scores to genomic and cellular features.
ai_technology: ML signature and survival associations are evaluated across nine datasets and against 66 published signatures; independent cohorts support retrospective prognostic discrimination.
organization: School of Pharmacy, Beihua University, Jilin, Jilin, China

evidence.tested: ML-selected six-gene telomerase signature stratified breast-cancer survival across cohorts and linked high scores to genomic and cellular features.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
